title: Normalized coherent raw evaluation commutes with affine etale restrictions
statement: Let f:X to S be quasi-compact and separated, G a quasi-coherent module on X, and q a natural number. For affine etale objects V,V' over S, h:V' to V, and any actual raw derived-Hom class z over V [def-weil-pbc-coherent-higher-image-classes], apply the raw presheaf restriction to z, evaluate it on V', and then apply the inverse uniquely normalized coherent comparison. The result equals the canonical module-cohomology restriction along h of the inverse normalized coherent comparison of the raw evaluation of z on V. The comparisons and tensor-composition restriction are precisely those of [def-weil-pbc-affine-cohomology-comparison-data]. This is only a compatibility square for fixed constructions, and asserts no descent, action, or realization isomorphism.

proof.text: Obtain theta, its universal section formula and the normalized comparison square from affineRealizationComparison_pullback. The proved typed raw-evaluation equation identifies evaluation of raw restriction with coherentEtalePullbackMap. Apply the affine comparison to this equation and compose with the normalized square at the raw evaluation of z. The bundled naturality theorem follows by the unchanged raw-coherent evaluation equations. Both public statements and every existing comparison and restriction definition remain unchanged.

theorem affineRealizationRawComparison_natural {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] (G : X.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (q : ℕ) (V V' : S.Etale) [IsAffine V.left] [IsAffine V'.left]
    (h : V' ⟶ V)
    (z : (Etale.abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf f q
      (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G)).obj (op V)) :
    affineRealizationAffineComparison f G q V'
        (affineRealizationRawEvaluation f G q V'
          ((Etale.abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf f q
            (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G)).map h.op z)) =
      affineRealizationRestriction f G q h
        (affineRealizationAffineComparison f G q V
          (affineRealizationRawEvaluation f G q V z))
